easyPrerequisites:
You have at least nine cards in your graveyard.

description:
Cast Ultimecia, Time Sorceress from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {3}{U}{B}.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
At the beginning of your end step, Ultimecia, Time Sorceress triggers, causing you to pay {4}{U}{U}{B}{B} and exile eight cards from your graveyard, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ultimecia, Omnipotent, causing you to mill seven cards.
